description: Configuration panel remote (JavaScript and CSS assets beside remoteEntry.js) on signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.14.0, measured at gzip level 9 the way snui-check-consumer measures it. Re-recorded from 47,933 on 0.11.1: the 0.13 line compacts the shipped style text, which more than pays for the announcer, label bundle, and field additions of the releases in between. The 5% growth band measures from this figure, so the gate catches unexpected growth rather than the upgrade itself.
